contract.task_clause:
Which of the following is a false statement about simple random samples?
Option A: A sample must be reasonably large to be properly considered a simple random sample.
Option B: Inspection of a sample will give no indication of whether or not it is a simple random sample.
Option C: Attributes of a simple random sample may be very different from attributes of the population.
Option D: Every element of the population has an equal chance of being picked.
